"'''Talon Nine'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|Starfighter Command]] as part of [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]].<ref name="WS" />

During a simple mission to follow a lone [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] in a New Republic-controlled system, Talon Squadron was [[Ambush at Gravan Seven|ambushed]] at [[Gravan Seven]] by numerically superior forces belonging to [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. "Talon Nine" [[Death/Legends|died]] when she banked into a volcano wall.<ref name="WS" />
